What Terex says to expect

  • Full year 2026: sales, adjusted EBITDA and free cash flowIt expects 2026 sales to grow approximately 8.5% on a pro forma 14 basis to $8.0 to $8.2 billion, Adjusted 1 EBITDA to grow by approximately 10% year over year on a pro forma 14 basis to between $930 million and $960 million, or 11.7% Adjusted 1 EBITDA margin at the mid-point, and Free cash flow of $360 million to $400 million.
The company's own words, from its earnings release (Form 8-K, Exhibit 99), filed October 28, 2026. They are its expectations, not ours, and not a forecast or price target from The Filing Desk. Replaced when the next release is out.
